title: Gate State Machine — Implementation Specification
purpose: Defines the formal state machine for readiness classification and certification gating. Specifies all valid states, state transitions, transition pre-conditions, auto-fail conditions, and escalation paths.

BLOCKED.label: Blocked — Structurally Impaired
BLOCKED.description: Item has identity, JSON integrity, or severe structural defects that make it unprocessable. Cannot enter any review pipeline.
BLOCKED.symptoms: Missing QID, missing CorrectChoice, unparseable JSON, DL-017 corruption artifacts
BLOCKED.resolution: Must be manually repaired before re-entering pipeline. Route to EditorialQueue with BLOCK_REASON.

REMEDIATE.label: Remediation Required
REMEDIATE.description: Item has structural or content defects that block certification but are automatically receivable (DL-008 clear, DL-026 fill, DL-016 alignment).
REMEDIATE.symptoms: Non-empty EW[CC], empty non-CC EW slot, metadata-content choice divergence
REMEDIATE.resolution: Can be remediated by authorized remediation script or editorial session. Post-remediation: re-enter Gate 1 for re-scan.

MINOR_FIX.label: Minor Fixes Recommended
MINOR_FIX.description: Item has content-quality issues that degrade educational value but do not affect answer correctness or create learner-safety risk.
MINOR_FIX.symptoms: Template boilerplate in EW, missing standard citation, suspected misassigned EW (unconfirmed), inflated difficulty
MINOR_FIX.resolution: Can be certified WITH WARNINGS. Warnings must be acknowledged by Certification Board. Can be remediated in editorial pass.

READY.label: Ready for Certification
READY.description: Item has passed all pre-flight gates. Eligible for Quality Board and Certification Board review.
triggers: All gates PASS (no HARD_FAIL, no SOFT_FAIL, no WARN)
READY.symptoms: All structural scans clean, all content scans clean, identity validated, JSON integrity confirmed
READY.resolution: Immediately eligible for CAQS §1.6 six-dimension verification.

CERTIFIED.label: Certified — Learner-Pool Eligible
CERTIFIED.description: Item has passed all pre-flight gates + certification board review. Available for learner practice sessions.
pre_conditions: Readiness classification must be READY or MINOR_FIX
Quality Board review complete with CERTIFY verdict

CERTIFIED_DELTA.label: Certified (Delta-Inherited)
CERTIFIED_DELTA.description: Item was previously Certified. Content hash unchanged. Prior certification decision inherited without re-review.
pre_conditions: No new scan findings since last certification
Goernance guard pre-flight gate PASS (Gates -1 through 4 re-run on current pack file state)

HOLD.label: Held — Certification Deferred
HOLD.description: Item is structurally clean but has unresolved quality concerns that prevent certification at this time.
triggers: Quality Board identifies accounting concern requiring human review
Certification Board escalates due to confidence < 90%
Pending remediation of dependent defect in template family sibling
HOLD.resolution: Resolve concern → re-enter certification pipeline. HOLD is temporary — items cannot remain HOLD past S900.

EDITORIAL_QUEUE.label: Editorial Queue — Awaiting Content Revision
EDITORIAL_QUEUE.description: Item requires content changes (explanation rewrite, choice revision, stem clarification) before re-entering certification.
triggers: CAQS rubric score < 70% on any dimension
EDITORIAL_QUEUE.resolution: Author makes content changes → re-enters pre-flight pipeline at Gate 0.

ARCHIVED.label: Archived — Preserved, Excluded from Active Pool
ARCHIVED.description: Item content preserved but excluded from learner delivery pool. Used for clones, superseded items, and rotation-artifact waste.
triggers: Designated as clone in template family (DL-012 pattern)
Rotation-artifact duplicate with zero pedagogical differentiation
ARCHIVED.resolution: Permanent (reversible only via explicit un-archive authorization). All content preserved — only question_state changes.

transitions.trigger: Quality Board identifies content revision needed
New certification wave, content_hash unchanged, all pre-flight gates PASS
Content revised → re-enter pipeline from start

forbidden_transitions: Certified → Unprocessed (must go through In Audit)
Certified → BLOCKED (Certified items cannot be blocked; they become REMEDIATE with escalated severity)
Archived → any state without explicit un-archive authorization
Unprocessed → Certified (must pass pre-flight + Quality Board + Certification Board)

auto_fail_conditions.description: Conditions that automatically route an item to BLOCKED or REMEDIATE regardless of other gate results.

conditions.condition: QID is null, undefined, or empty string
CorrectChoice is null, undefined, empty, or not A-D
conditions.action: BLOCKED — no answer key of reference

conditions.condition: Pack file unparseable via AM-1 and AM-2
conditions.action: BLOCKED — all items in pack blocked until file repaired
BLOCKED for affected items — file corruption must be repaired
BLOCKED for entire pack — pipeline halted until count reconciled
REMEDIATE with severity CRITICAL — learner pool exposure
REMEDIATE with severity CRITICAL — wrong answer in pool

conditions.condition: DL-016 SEVERE (EW text topically unrelated to item)

escalation_paths.description: When an item cannot be auto-classified or requires human judgment, it escalates through defined paths.

tier1_human_review.trigger: Confidence < 90% on any AI-derived classification (DL-010 suspect, DL-030 suspect, DL-031 borderline)
tier1_human_review.action: Flag item for human editorial review. Do not auto-remediate. Escalate to Quality Board with evidence package.

tier2_governance.trigger: Certified item with CRITICAL severity defect (DL-008 + Certified, DL-030 CONFIRMED + Certified)
tier2_governance.action: Immediate governance alert. Item marked in defect manifest. Session plan prioritizes this item as P0. Governance Board must acknowledge before session close.

tier3_structural_repair.trigger: Pack-file corruption, identity collision, or cross-pack QID overlap
tier3_structural_repair.action: Escalate to Governance Board. Session cannot close until resolved. Pack file quarantined from all write operations until structural integrity restored.

exports.getAvailableTransitions(currentState): Returns array of valid destination states
exports.validateState(item): Returns { valid, warnings } — checks if current state is consistent with gate results
